about: Utterances for the voice latency harness (bench/voice, server/app/bench_voice.py). Kairo's own voices render them once into <data>/bench/corpus; recordings dropped into <data>/bench/own/<id>.wav take precedence. Generic lines only, no personal data, and nothing that asks Kairo to change anything: a live run is a real call.
